        (fig. 43)

   Orient the antennas so that the director ele-
ments face in the direction of the distant station.
The director elements are the straight sections of
the antenna array that are attached to the half of
the boom to which the junction box is attached.

the desired position. Drive a spare stake beside
the gin pole and lash the gin pole to it. This is
